name: Winter at Weather Corp.
source:
Welcome to Weather Corp! Join a tired paper pusher and their plucky new intern as they oblige their supervisor's sudden new project and try to make it snow in Los Angeles for the Winter!

[From [url=https://iszacstartown.itch.io/winter-at-weather-corp]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到天气公司！与疲惫的推纸工和勇敢的新实习生一起完成主管突然提出的新项目，并努力让洛杉矶下雪过冬！

[来自[url=https://iszacstartown.itch.io/winter-at-weather-corp]itch.io[/url]]
